title: Ban on Suboxone use for ‘safety-sensitive’ roles draws EEOC lawsuit
summary: The employer, Bollinger Shipyards, allegedly booted five candidates from its application process because of their prescription drug use.

title: AI might be making women sound less sophisticated
summary: A study out of Johns Hopkins found that chatbots prompted with “woman-associated language” produced responses that were less complex than men’s.

title: California revamps AI protections for workers in flurry of bill signings
summary: Gov. Gavin Newsom said the laws aim to create a “nation-leading framework” for protecting workers and consumers.

title: This week in 5 numbers: HR pros say half of their week is spent on repetitive work
summary: Here’s a roundup of numbers from the last week — including how much it costs employees to return to the office.

title: The RTO tax is an estimated $6,700 per year for employees, analysis finds
summary: For working parents paying for childcare, that figure climbs to about $16,000 annually, per Resume.io.

title: Ghost jobs and fake applicants have created a hiring trust gap
summary: While companies say that fraudulent candidates are complicating the recruiting process, job seekers are also concerned about scams, an iHire report said.

title: Esker folds AI into employee cost analysis
summary: The finance software firm is now treating AI spending as another component of an employee’s cost alongside salary, bonuses and payroll taxes, the CFO said.

title: Value-based care could cut healthcare costs. Employers aren’t buying it.
summary: Nearly half of companies don’t plan to make any changes to their value-based arrangements in the next three years, EY found.

title: Christian worker allegedly fired for religious social media posts gets $20K
summary: Employers have some discretion to discipline employees over social media content, but federal laws prohibit unfavorable treatment because of religious beliefs, EEOC has said.

title: Lesbian plaintiff fails to show employer’s fertility benefits were biased under SCOTUS test
summary: The case demonstrates how courts have had to parse the implications of the high court’s 2020 decision in Bostock v. Clayton County, Ga.
